title: The role of ultrasound in enhancing mesenchymal stromal cell-based therapies
summary:
an implementation of the interacting quantum atoms method for crystals is presented . 
 it provides a real spaceenergy decomposition of the energy of crystals in which all energy
components are physically meaningful . the new package ChemIntables one to compute intra- and inter - atomic energies , as well as electron population measures used for quantitative description of chemical bonds in crystals .    * keywords : * quantum mechanics , quantum chemistry , crystal structure , chemical bonding , ionic and covalent interactions , interatomic interactions , quantum theory of atoms in molecules in molecules ( qtaim )
key_findings: Ultrasound enhances the efficacy of mesenchymal stromal cell therapies.
The method provides a real space energy decomposition for crystal energy.
ChemIntables allows computation of intra- and inter-atomic energies.
methodology: The study employs the interacting quantum atoms method to analyze crystal structures and energy components.
limitations: The applicability of the method may be limited to specific types of crystals.
Potential computational complexity in larger systems.
future_work: Explore the application of ultrasound in other cell-based therapies.
Investigate the method's effectiveness in different crystal structures.
